info.title: ZondScan Public API
info.description:
ZondScan is the block explorer for the QRL 2.0 (Zond) public testnet. This API is free to use: no API key, no signup. On-chain data reflects the QRL 2.0 testnet, and testnet coins have no monetary value. The market order-book endpoint serves public QRL/USDT spot data from MEXC.

CORS: GET endpoints respond with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and can be called directly from any web page. POST endpoints allow cross-origin browser access only from the explorer's own origins and from browser-extension origins, so browser apps hosted elsewhere should treat POST endpoints as server-side calls.

Pagination: list endpoints take page and limit query parameters, and limit is capped at 100 items. Most list endpoints number pages from 1; the contract and token list endpoints number pages from 0. Each operation documents its own defaults.

Numeric encoding: on-chain quantities (block fields, gas values, raw transaction values) are 0x-prefixed hexadecimal strings. Indexed aggregates are decimal strings or JSON numbers. Coin amounts are denominated in Quanta (1 Quanta = 10^9 Shor = 10^18 Planck); fields carrying exact amounts use decimal strings.

Caching and limits: hot endpoints are cached server side for 3 to 30 seconds, noted per operation. The three POST contract endpoints carry per-IP rate limits and return 429 with body {"error": "rate limit exceeded"} when exhausted.

get.description: Pings the database with a 3 second budget. Returns 200 when the API can reach its data store and 503 when it cannot.
Homepage hero data: market figures, wallet count, circulating supply, daily volume, validator count, and contract count in one call. Cached server side for 10 seconds.

circulating.description: Circulating supply in Quanta as a decimal string.

dataInitialized.description: False while the indexer has not yet written its first market and supply samples.

get.description: Price, market cap, and volume snapshots for charts and wallet apps.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Time window for the returned samples.

200.description: Price history for the requested interval.

get.description: Returns a server-side snapshot of the fixed MEXC QRLUSDT spot market: up to 100 bid levels, 100 ask levels, 100 recent trades, and 24-hour ticker data. Successful snapshots and upstream failures are cached for 3 seconds, limiting MEXC request bursts during rate limits or outages. This public endpoint requires no MEXC API key and accepts no venue, symbol, or upstream URL parameters.

502.description: MEXC returned an invalid response or could not be reached within the request budget.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before ZondScan will attempt another MEXC fetch.

get.summary: Collected fund flow by trade size
get.description: Rolls up publicly collected venue executions into buy and sell volume per trade-size band, a net-inflow series across the selected window, and five days of daily net inflow. Size bands are ZondScan's own classification by quote notional and are reported in the response so clients can label them with real numbers; no venue publishes this split. Venues expose no historical trade tape, so this history accumulates forward from the moment collection starts and cannot be backfilled. The coverage object states how much of the requested window is actually backed by stored trades. Results are cached for 30 seconds per venue and window.

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Venue id to roll up. Defaults to the first configured venue.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Rollup window.

200.description: Fund-flow rollup for the requested venue and window.

get.description: Returns the latest synced block number as a decimal integer, plus the current QRL/USD price so fee displays need no second request. Cached server side for 5 seconds.

200.description: Latest block height and spot price.

get.description: Newest blocks first, with a per-block activity rollup (token transfers and internal calls). The reported total is capped at 300 pages worth of blocks. Cached server side for 10 seconds.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Blocks per page. Capped at 100.

total.description: Total block count, capped at 300 pages at the current limit.

blockActivity.description: Map keyed by the block's 0x-prefixed hex number. Present only for blocks with token or internal-call activity.

get.description: Fetches one block by number, in decimal or 0x-prefixed hex form, plus per-transaction activity counts.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Block number as a decimal integer or 0x-prefixed hex string.

200.description: Block detail with per-transaction activity map.

txActivity.description: Map keyed by transaction hash. Present only for transactions with token or internal-call activity.

get.description: Precomputed block size samples for charts, sorted by timestamp ascending and capped at 2000 points. Cached server side for 30 seconds.

items.description: One sample per block. blockNumber, timestamp, and size are 0x-prefixed hex strings; transactionCount is an integer.

get.description: Network-wide confirmed transactions, newest first, with the total count and the latest block height for confirmation math. Cached server side for 10 seconds.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

get.description: Fixed-size feed of the most recent confirmed transactions, used by the homepage. Cached server side for 5 seconds.

Full detail for one confirmed transaction: transfer record, live receipt status and event logs, calldata, token transfers, internal calls, and contract metadata for decoding. This endpoint is deliberately uncached so a newly mined transaction shows its true confirmation count immediately.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Transaction hash: 0x followed by 64 hex characters.

200.description: Transaction detail. Optional fields appear only when the transaction has the corresponding data.

latestBlock.description: Latest indexed block height as a decimal integer.

receiptStatus.description: EVM receipt status: 0x1 success, 0x0 reverted. Absent when the receipt fetch failed.

input.description: Transaction calldata as a 0x-prefixed hex string. Present for contract calls.

get.description: Returns the stored transfer record for one transaction hash. A missing transaction still returns 200 with an empty record; this preserves the endpoint's historical behavior.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Transaction hash: 0x followed by 64 hex characters.

200.description: Transfer record, empty when the hash is unknown.

get.description: Transactions currently observed in the mempool. Cached server side for 5 seconds, matching mempool turnover.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

get.description: Detail for one mempool transaction, including verified-contract metadata for the recipient when available. Returns 404 once the transaction has been mined or dropped; clients then fetch /api/tx/{hash} for the confirmed payload.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Transaction hash: 0x followed by 64 hex characters.

404.description: Transaction has been mined, dropped, or was never seen. The body's status field is "mined" when the transaction confirmed.

get.summary: Inclusion ETA for a pending transaction
get.description: Best-effort estimate of when a pending transaction will be included, derived from recent block statistics and the gas queued ahead of it in the mempool. Cached server side for 5 seconds.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Transaction hash: 0x followed by 64 hex characters.

etaSec.description: Estimated seconds until inclusion, at minimum one average block time.

gasAheadHex.description: 0x-prefixed hex sum of gas queued at a higher or equal gas price.

yourGasPriceHex.description: 0x-prefixed hex gas price of the queried transaction.

404.description: The transaction is no longer pending.

get.description: Everything the address page needs in one call: balance record, transaction counts, activity range, richlist rank, paginated transaction and internal-transaction lists, and contract metadata when the address is a contract. Cached server side for 10 seconds.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for the transaction lists, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

address.description: Indexed balance record. balance is a JSON number denominated in Quanta.

first_seen.description: Unix timestamp of the first indexed activity, 0 when none.

last_seen.description: Unix timestamp of the latest indexed activity, 0 when none.

contract_code.description: Contract record when the address is a contract, empty otherwise.

get.description: Paginated list of value-moving transactions touching the address.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

get.description: Token and NFT transfer events where the address is sender or recipient, across every contract.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

get.description: All indexed token holdings for a wallet. By default every standard is returned (ERC-20 plus per-id ERC-721 and ERC-1155 rows); use the standard filter to scope to one.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: standard
parameters.description: Scope the response to one token standard.

get.description: Per (contract, tokenID) NFT holdings joined with collection metadata and per-token off-chain metadata (name, image, attributes) in one call. Covers ERC-721 and ERC-1155.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: standard
parameters.description: Scope the response to one NFT standard.

get.description: Wallet ranking by indexed balance, with contract flag, first-seen timestamp, and supply share per row. Cached server side for 30 seconds.

get.summary: Count addresses above a balance threshold
get.description: Returns the number of indexed addresses whose balance exceeds a threshold derived from the supplied value. The value is scaled by 10^12 before comparison against the indexed balance.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Threshold value as a decimal integer.

400.description: Value is invalid as a decimal integer.

post.summary: Live balance lookup via the node
post.description: Form-encoded balance lookup proxied to the node's qrl_getBalance. Always returns 200: on success balance is a JSON number denominated in Quanta, and on failure balance is an error message string. Because POST endpoints carry a restricted CORS policy, cross-origin browser apps should use GET /api/address/aggregate/{address} instead; it is open to every origin and includes the indexed balance.

200.description: Balance in Quanta as a number, or an error message string in the same field.

get.description: Deployed contracts with optional search and filters. Pagination is 0-indexed on this endpoint.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text filter over contract fields.

parameters.name: isToken
parameters.description: Filter to token contracts (true) or non-token contracts (any other value).

parameters.name: standard
parameters.description: Filter by token standard.

get.description: Counts of deployed contracts bucketed by token standard, plus an "other" bucket for non-token contracts. Cached server side for 30 seconds.
Summary statistics for one token contract: identity, supply, holder count, transfer count, and creation provenance.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Contract address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

totalSupply.description: Raw supply as a decimal string, before dividing by decimals.

genesisContract.description: True for contracts baked into the genesis allocation.

get.description: Holders of a token contract. For NFT contracts an optional tokenID filter scopes to holders of one id; without it holders are aggregated across all ids. Pagination is 0-indexed on this endpoint.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Contract address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: tokenID
parameters.description: Filter holders to one NFT token id (decimal string).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

get.summary: Minted token ids on an NFT contract
get.description: Distinct token ids minted on an NFT contract with per-id holder counts and, when fetched, off-chain metadata (name, image, description). Returns an empty list for ERC-20 contracts. Pagination is 0-indexed on this endpoint.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Contract address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

get.description: Transfer events emitted by one token contract, newest first. Pagination is 0-indexed on this endpoint.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Contract address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

get.description: Full off-chain metadata for one (contract, tokenID) pair, including OpenSea-style attributes. The id must be a decimal integer; the concrete sibling segments (info, holders, tokens, transfers) take priority over this route.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Contract address: Q or 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Token id as a decimal integer, at most 80 characters.

404.description: No metadata stub exists for this token.

get.description: The full validator set with per-validator status, age, and stake, plus the current epoch and the total staked amount. Cached server side for 30 seconds.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Reserved for future server-side pagination. The full set is returned today.

index.description: Validator index as a decimal string.

address.description: Validator public key as unprefixed hex: ML-DSA-87, 5184 hex characters. Examples are truncated for readability.

stakedAmount.description: Effective balance as a decimal string, as reported by the beacon chain.

epoch.description: Current epoch as a decimal string.

totalStaked.description: Sum of effective balances as a decimal string.

get.description: Per-epoch historical validator counts for charts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of history records. Capped at 100.

get.description: Totals across the validator set: counts per status, total staked, and the current epoch.
Detail for one validator, addressed by decimal index.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Validator index as a decimal integer.

get.description: Beacon chain epochs, newest first, with per-epoch validator counts and finality status.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Capped at 100.

get.description: Head, finalized, and justified epoch state plus slot timing for the beacon chain.
Per-slot breakdown of one epoch: proposed and missed slots, proposers, and validator statistics at that epoch.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Epoch number as a decimal integer.

404.description: The epoch is invalid or has not yet occurred.

get.description: Headline gas price plus block and mempool statistics and a gas price histogram. Gas values are 0x-prefixed hex strings. Cached server side for 5 seconds.

avgGasPriceHex.description: Headline gas price: median over recent transfers, 0x-prefixed hex.

get.description: Per-block gas history for the last 24 hours, or hourly buckets for the 7 day range. Unrecognized range values fall back to 24h. Cached server side for 30 seconds.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Time range for the series.

post.description: Enqueues an async source-verification job compiled with the Hyperion toolchain. Request bodies are capped at 1 MiB. Rate limited per IP: bucket of 5 requests, refilling 5 per minute. Poll GET /api/contract/verify/{jobId} for the outcome.

address.description: Canonical Q-prefixed contract address (uppercase Q plus 40 hex characters).

compilerVersion.description: Build id from /api/contract/compiler-info. Empty selects the default build.

200.description: The contract is already verified; no new job was created.

400.description: Invalid body, invalid address, missing required fields, or unsupported compilerVersion (the body lists supported builds).

409.description: A verification job is already in flight for this address.

503.description: Contract verification is not configured on this deployment.

get.description: Returns the verification job document. Status moves through pending, compiling, and then success or failed.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Job id returned by POST /api/contract/verify.

get.description: Lists every selectable Hyperion compiler build and identifies the default. Use a listed buildId as the compilerVersion in verify submissions.

503.description: Contract verification is not configured on this deployment.

post.description: Typed proxy for qrl_call against the latest block, scoped to addresses the explorer knows as contracts. Calldata is capped at 8 KiB of hex, request bodies at 32 KiB, gas at 50 million, and each call at an 8 second timeout. Rate limited per IP: bucket of 60 requests, refilling 60 per minute.

data.description: ABI-encoded calldata: 0x-prefixed, even-length, lowercase hex. 0x alone is allowed for zero-argument functions.

200.description: Call result. A reverted execution also returns 200, with reverted true and the upstream error message.

result.description: Return data as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

400.description: Invalid body, address, or calldata encoding.

404.description: The to address is unknown as a contract to the explorer.

502.description: The node call failed or returned an undecodable response.

post.summary: AI explanation of a verified contract
post.description: Generates or returns a cached plain-language explanation of a verified contract's source. Only verified contracts can be analyzed. Rate limited per IP: bucket of 10 requests, refilling 4 per minute. Regeneration is capped at 5 per contract per 7 day window.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Canonical Q-prefixed contract address.

parameters.name: regenerate
parameters.description: Set to 1 or true to force a fresh explanation instead of the cached one.

403.description: The contract exists and is unverified, so it cannot be analyzed.

404.description: The address is unknown as a contract.

429.description: Per-IP rate limit exceeded, or the per-contract regeneration cap (5 per 7 day window) was reached.

502.description: The explanation provider failed; retry shortly.

503.description: The AI explainer is not configured on this deployment.

get.description: Resolves a free-form query (address, transaction hash, or block number) and responds with a 302 redirect to the matching explorer page. Unresolvable queries redirect to the homepage. Served by the explorer web app.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Address (Q or 0x plus 40 hex), transaction hash (64 hex, 0x optional), or block number (decimal or 0x hex).

302.description: Redirect to the resolved detail page, or to the homepage when the query cannot be resolved.

Location.description: Absolute URL of the matching page on https://zondscan.com.

get.description: Public faucet configuration so clients can render the claim form or a disabled state. Served by the explorer web app.

dripQuanta.description: Whole-Quanta amount sent per successful claim, as a decimal string.

cooldownHours.description: Cooldown window in hours, enforced per address and per IP.

post.description: Sends a drip of testnet Quanta to the given address. Gated by a Cloudflare Turnstile captcha token, a per-address and per-IP cooldown (default 24 hours), and an optional rolling 24 hour global cap on total dripped Quanta. Testnet coins have no monetary value. Served by the explorer web app.

address.description: Q-prefixed recipient address (Q plus 40 hex characters).

amount.description: Amount sent, in whole Quanta as a decimal string.

explorerUrl.description: Relative explorer path for the broadcast transaction.

400.description: Invalid body, invalid address, or failed captcha verification.

429.description: Cooldown active for this address or IP. The body carries retryAfterSeconds and the response sets a Retry-After header.

502.description: The signed transaction could not be broadcast.

503.description: Faucet unavailable: unconfigured, captcha missing in production, out of funds, or the daily cap was reached.

MarketPriceLevel.description: One aggregated order-book price level. Decimal strings preserve exact values without floating-point conversion.

MarketTrade.description: One recent MEXC public trade. The API synthesizes a stable id when MEXC returns null. aggressorSide is the taker side inferred from isBuyerMaker.

MarketTicker.description: Normalized decimal-string fields from MEXC's 24-hour ticker.

changePercent.description: MEXC's raw 24-hour change rate. Multiply by 100 for percent units.

quoteVolume.description: 24-hour USDT volume. MEXC can return null.

bids.description: Bid levels in MEXC order, highest price first. Up to 500 per side; QRLUSDT's resting bid book is smaller than that, so this side is usually complete.

asks.description: Ask levels in MEXC order, lowest price first. Up to 500 per side.

id.description: Stable venue key accepted by the venue query parameter.

MarketSizeBands.description: ZondScan's own trade-size thresholds in quote notional, reported so clients can label bands with real numbers.

mediumFrom.description: Inclusive floor of the medium band.

largeFrom.description: Inclusive floor of the large band.

MarketFlowBucket.description: Buy and sell split for one size band. Quantities are in the base asset (QRL); quote values are in the venue quote asset.

time.description: Inclusive start of the step, as Unix milliseconds.

MarketFlowCoverage.description: How much of the requested window is backed by collected trades. This API cannot backfill, so a window can legitimately be only partly covered.

firstTradeAt.description: Timestamp of the oldest stored trade for this venue.

complete.description: True when collection began at or before the window start.

venues.description: Every configured venue, so a client can offer a venue switcher.

seriesStepMs.description: Width of one series step in milliseconds.

buckets.description: One entry per size band, largest first, zero-filled when a band saw no trades.

series.description: Net inflow per step across the window, zero-filled.

daily.description: Net inflow per UTC day for the last five days.

BlockResult.description: One execution-layer block. All numeric fields are 0x-prefixed hex strings.

BlockTransaction.description: A transaction as embedded in a block document. Numeric fields are 0x-prefixed hex strings. The signature and publicKey fields carry the ML-DSA-87 signature material.

Transfer.description: Stored transfer record for one transaction. BlockNumber, BlockTimestamp, Value, GasUsed, GasPrice, Nonce, and Size are 0x-prefixed hex strings. Signature is the transaction's ML-DSA-87 signature and Pk is the signer's public key.

GasUsed.description: Actual gas consumed when the receipt is available, the gas limit otherwise.

Input.description: Calldata as a 0x-prefixed hex string. Present for contract calls.

TransactionByAddress.description: One indexed transaction row. Amount and PaidFees are exact decimal strings denominated in Quanta with 18 fractional digits. BlockNumber and TimeStamp are decimal strings.

InOut.description: Direction flag relative to the indexed address.

PendingTransaction.description: A mempool transaction. Gas, value, and nonce fields are 0x-prefixed hex strings; lastSeen and createdAt are Unix timestamps.

TokenTransfer.description: One token transfer event. amount is a raw decimal string, before dividing by tokenDecimals.

TokenBalance.description: One token holding. balance is a raw decimal string, before dividing by decimals. NFT rows carry tokenID and tokenStandard.

NFTBalance.description: One NFT holding joined with collection and per-token metadata.

ContractMeta.description: Compact contract metadata attached to logs and call targets. The abi field is present only for verified contracts.

ContractInfo.description: A contract record. Verified contracts additionally carry source, ABI, and compiler settings; token contracts carry name, symbol, decimals, and standard.
